g18_plan.stage: G18 prospective observability diagnosis, known functional ANOVA contrast, not a complete/new I learner
g18_plan.teacher_only: 8 repeated2D modules,2ReLU per module,4freshGaussian codes per source. Orthogonal four-point mixing produces another signed4-code I with C/2. Input and hidden coordinates permuted, unknown to graph learner.32 versus128 active weights.
g18_plan.query_policy: At each base X,Z: base, every single replacement and every pair replacement;Q137. All queries marginalGaussian, panel dependent. Two independent Gaussian labels per query. Same X,Z,unit noises and underlying C across variants/noise for paired diagnosis. Count2*T*N*Q labels; raw panels not stored. Such queries require active/simulator access, cannot be reconstructed from arbitrary IID files.
g18_plan.learner: For every pair, squared mean-label rectangle contrast divided by2 observed sigmahat^2, estimated independently from all replicate differences. Exact null F(TN,TNQ). No teacher mask/component count/code values or population moments in decision.
g18_plan.alpha_scope: Per family/variant/noise run across all5 looks and120 pair nulls. No whole-benchmark/cross-algorithm guarantee. Controls false edges only, not omissions, correct components or full weight-I.
g18_plan.selection: No HPO, teacher stopping or look selection. Store every registered graph. Freeze all12 network source outputs before structural/population oracle audit.
g18_plan.oracle_audit: Independently evaluate population m0/m1/m2,label-square H2/gradient anisotropic part,m3; different f on same fresh Gaussian X and equal f under known orthogonal input transform. This is oracle construction verification, not learned-I performance. Input interaction graph scored separately from I.
g18_plan.limits: Known Sobol/pick-freeze statistic; no novelty or competitor superiority claim. Cheap bilinear Sobol estimators and same-panel native LC/Yeh/LUT-Q still required before full-I comparison. Gaussian iid measurement noise only; heavy-tail/heteroscedastic coverage unproved.
g18_plan.checks: No software tests. Necessary mathematical/provenance/finiteness guards, minimal lint and figure inspection only.

learner: Estimate positive code magnitudes from summed even axis queries by ordinary segmented-LS initialization and variable projection. Expand learned prefixes by0/+-codes. data: Underlying G19 teachers/C and exact frozen slices, noisy slice repeats4096, no-noise1; hash-verify regeneration. New fixed axis train+midpoint-validation grids and paired Gaussian sample means, count r labels/query. Per-axis budget=(2*257-1)*coarseR; r=floor(budget/(2*grid-1)). Noiseless r1, duplicate precision budgets omitted. Axis cost includes validation queries, plus full old slices; extremely large virtual label budgets explicit.
audit: Entire18-job/540-method-state cohort freezes before G20 teacher-C/mass/I metrics. Old G19 upper-controls already opened and kept separate. Check underlying frozen slice hashes before learner; audit masses and numerical bound only after whole freeze.
limits: Known commonb/readout and one function/I. No new multi-source benchmark, transfer, misspecified-noise guarantee or native competitor comparison. High-noise unchanged prefix solver already failed with trueC. New component not claimed novel or superior.

methods_detail: Continuous baseline same objective and7starts asG19 but all G20 restart choices use independent interleaved axis-validation. DP-start replaces only first start, same6 others. Integer-mass uses same7starts and fixed positive integer masses from relaxed DP. Raw DP physicality/bound/refit separate; no exact continuous-spline guarantee.
selection: Independent noisy axis-validation chooses one of7 numerical starts within each method/panel. No teacher/hard-I/budget/grid selection. Save every registered result. No inferred C or I from known-C oracle controls passed to learner.
